reconstruction_summary: Reconstructed V3 (agent's final variant: per-platform delta_offset + understeer K_us + integer lag) from out/ladder/summary.json coefficients (Mach-E: off=-2.76e-4, K_us=2e-4, lag=+1; Lightning: off=-7.75e-4, K_us=4.5e-3, lag=+1) using psi_dot = v*(delta+off)/(L + K_us*v^2) then np.roll by lag with first sample invalidated.
notes: V3 lag rolls predictions by +1 sample per segment, invalidating the first sample; agent_rmse pooled over 1364476 samples vs baseline pooled over 1364925. Baseline-recomputed matches canonical to within numerical precision.
